subset.note: partial CPU extraction (first 3 of 6 chunks of each of 4 id shards); both encoders are scored on exactly these clips; clips are sorted by speed in id order, so all three bands are covered but not uniformly

static_disk_control: not run: no zero-speed clips exist in the supplied sets (speed 0.25-4 m/s; direction-set velocity clips 1-7 m/s, accelerating clips start at rest but reach >= 2 m/s^2 * tau; acceleration set >= 0.25 m/s^2); rendering + extracting a static set needs the GPU

keys.speed/random/timepool.{clock,decode,geom: same fields as p5_time_manifold.json clock / decode / geometry, on the random-init encoder's speed-set timepool (artifacts extracted on CPU with scripts/extract.py run --model random --store-timepool; meanpool rows checked against artifacts/activations/speed/random/meanpool.npy)
keys.odometer_prediction_as_ratio: held-out (non-knot) clips per band; an odometer predicts fast slope / slow slope = odometer_slope_ratio (= mean speed ratio; sqrt of the acceleration ratio for the acceleration set, from rest); a clock predicts 1
